day_chosen_requires_option.name: day_chosen_requires_option
day_chosen_requires_option.value: "day"."status" NOT IN ('chosen', 'edited') OR "day"."chosen_option_id" IS NOT NULL

day_weekly_gym_pair.name: day_weekly_gym_pair
day_weekly_gym_pair.value:
("day"."weekly_gym_done" IS NULL) = ("day"."weekly_gym_target" IS NULL)
        AND ("day"."weekly_gym_done" IS NULL OR ("day"."weekly_gym_done" >= 0 AND "day"."weekly_gym_target" > 0))

day_review_complete.name: day_review_complete
day_review_complete.value:
("day"."review_energy" IS NULL) = ("day"."review_mood" IS NULL)
        AND ("day"."review_text" IS NULL OR "day"."review_energy" IS NOT NULL)

sleep_log_order.name: sleep_log_order
sleep_log_order.value:
"sleep_log"."bed_at" IS NULL OR "sleep_log"."woke_at" IS NULL
        OR ("sleep_log"."woke_at" > "sleep_log"."bed_at" AND "sleep_log"."woke_at" - "sleep_log"."bed_at" < interval '20 hours')
